The 2026-11-13 rows in the same release were NOT transcribed: those games had already tipped, and the 11/13 slate is covered by injury_report_2026-11-13.json (04:15 PM ET release).

provenance.publisher: NBA Referee Operations (official NBA injury report, published on the NBA's own CDN)
provenance.cadence_note: Per official.nba.com/nba-injury-report-2026-27-season/: day-before designations are due by 5 p.m. local time the day before a game (second day of a back-to-back: 1 p.m. local on game day); game-day reports are submitted between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. local time (8-10 a.m. for tip-offs 5 p.m. or earlier); reports are updated on a continual basis throughout the day. This 19:30 ET release therefore carries the first official participation designations for the 2026-11-14 slate (five teams had filed; five had not).
